name: Capture the ankle without a finish
starting_position: You begin in familiar ashi garami with your outside elbow on the mat and the ankle not yet secured.
user_objective: Capture the ankle in your armpit and retain the foot-and-leg connection without squeezing.
partner_objective: Deny the capture and free the leg.
reset_condition: Continuous capture/retention task; reset when the partner frees the leg. Release completely if either partner feels joint pressure.
